title.value: AICOM-MP: An AI-Based Monkeypox Detector for Resource-Constrained Environments
title.justification: The paper presents "AICOM-MP," an AI-based monkeypox detector developed for resource-constrained environments, primarily using autonomous mobile clinics (AMCs).
title.quote: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE -CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS

extractions.description: The paper introduces AICOM-MP, an AI-based detector for monkeypox, aimed at enhancing healthcare access in resource-constrained environments such as Least Developed Countries (LDCs) through Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs). The paper details the performance of AICOM-MP, offers a methodology for developing health AI technologies for AMCs, and highlights its deployment as a web service to allow universal access to monkeypox screening.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on developing health AI technology to detect monkeypox rather than on climate change or its implications.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Under the Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) initiative, we are developing, open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on climate change but rather on health AI technology for detecting monkeypox.
primary_category.quote: Particularly, starting with monkeypox, we have realized that many existing health AI engines fail to handle a wide spectrum of data, and especially fail to perform on images taken from resource-constrained devices.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper addresses healthcare access in Least Developed Countries (LDCs), which can be linked to supporting the Global South in terms of infrastructure and technological advancement.
secondary_categories.quote: A key contribution of the current work is to make monkeypox screening available in resource-restrained environments, which is essential to enable healthcare access for people from LDCs.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not align with any specific climate change sub-category as listed.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this article, we introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector specially aiming for handling images taken from resource-constrained devices.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper involves sharing knowledge and methodologies for developing AI technologies in resource-constrained environments, akin to policy advice and knowledge sharing, especially for the Global South.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We have open sourced both the source code and the dataset of AICOM-MP to allow health AI professionals to integrate AICOM-MP into their services.

applications.value: AI-based monkeypox detection for resource-constrained environments
applications.justification: The paper's specific application is deploying AI-based solutions for monkeypox detection in environments with limited resources.
applications.quote: Under the AMCs initiative and facing the recent global monkeypox outbreak, in this article we introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector that has achieved SOTA performance and capable of handling images taken from resource constrained devices.

new_primary_category.justification: No new climate change category is required as the paper's theme does not directly relate to climate change topics.
new_primary_category.quote: Health AI engines are applications on AMCs, this article presents the first case of 'application' development on and beyond AMCs.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's subject matter does not introduce a sub-category relevant to climate change.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: AICOM-MP is required to handle pictures taken by various devices, especially low-resolution images taken on resource-constrained devices.
